projects.title: 193Tees E-commerce Website
projects.description:
This is an e-commerce website intended to promote the art community in Davis, CA by having artists submit designs to us and selling them to UC Davis students. See bit.ly/193tees for more information.

The primary basis of this project is focused on using existing components and API's to develop the website, as well as using a suite of Google tools (App Engine, Analytics, Adwords) to track metrics and ensure site reliability. 

The technology of this website is based on a model-view-controller architecture implemented with a MEAN stack framework (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js). Site reliability is ensured by having a prober (written in R) periodically ping the website on a set interval 24/7.
